Coach Eduardo Domínguez is expected to field the following Atlético-MG lineup against Coritiba: Gabriel Delfim; Natanael, Léo Duarte, Vitor Hugo and Kauã Pascini; Kevin Castaño, Alexsander, Bernard and Igor Gomes; Alan Minda and Thiago Borbas. [...] Natanael is expected to play at right-back, while Léo Duarte and Vitor Hugo are options at center-back. Kauã Pascini could also feature at left-back. The selections will depend on the players' fitness assessments and the coach's final decision before the match.

Alan Franco's absence calls for a reshuffle in midfield. Kevin Castaño, Alexsander and Igor Gomes are among the alternatives, as Eduardo Domínguez looks to maintain a balance between defensive duties and building attacks.
